params.body:
Six small things Shane asked for on the dealer settings (2026-09-15), one PR, one screen rule R P2-10.21. Builds on PR 399 (settings on a phone) and reuses its classes.

## What changed for the user

**Achtergrond.** Next to Verwijderen there is now Downloaden: a link to `GET settings/background/{dark|light}/download` (`settings.show.background`) that streams the original as an attachment named `achtergrond-donker.<ext>` / `achtergrond-licht.<ext>`. The record is found the way the pane finds it: the dealer's own row, the platform row (dealer_id null) only for whoever has `removebgkey.index`; another dealer's background, an unknown type or a missing file is a 404, and without the pane right (`background.index`) a 403. The button only renders when a background is set. The key field reads "remove.bg API-sleutel" with one quiet line under the label saying what it is; the existing "Er is een sleutel ingesteld. Laat leeg om ze te behouden." stays.

**Bijlagen.** Choosing a file now names it under the field at once (Alpine `x-on:change`): "Geselecteerd: <naam>. Klik Opslaan om de bestaande bijlage te vervangen." The existing-attachment line shows the stored file name (`attachment.pdf`, the only name `updateAttachment()` writes). The file field is now also present when an attachment exists, so that sentence is true: before, replacing meant deleting first, while the controller already replaced the file on save. No change to the save path.

**Support.** The mailto button stays; under it "of mail naar contact@stocklistdealer.eu" as a visible mailto link with a small Kopiëren button (`navigator.clipboard`, `ui.notify('Adres gekopieerd')`). One source for the address: `config('variable.support_email')` (env `SUPPORT_EMAIL`, default `contact@stocklistdealer.eu`). The 503 page keeps its literal for now; not touched.

**Stored secrets.** A stored secret now says so: a chip "Sleutel ingesteld" / "Wachtwoord ingesteld" (new `ui-badge--state`, the register of "alleen beheerder" plus a check) next to the label and a `••••••••` placeholder, on the remove.bg key, the RealGarant password and the Car-Pass password of the dealer form (the same "Laat leeg om te behouden" pattern; the VWE and Nederland Mobiel tab is read-only since R P2-10.15, so nothing to do there). RealGarant: `updateWarranty()` keeps the stored password on an empty submit, so replacing is typing a new one and Opslaan; there is no separate replace button. The old "Reset password" button was the delete (`warranty_password_reset`, the only thing that removes the row), so it stays as "Wachtwoord verwijderen" (nl/en/fr/de/es), is disabled while something is typed (deleting and replacing in one save contradict), and the help line now reads "Er staat een wachtwoord. Typ een nieuw wachtwoord om het te vervangen; leeg laten behoudt het." No jQuery on it (it was already Alpine).

**Website (1440).** Every `ui-toggle-row` is a grid `minmax(0,1fr) auto`: first child the label, second the control (right-aligned in one column), optional third a quiet description (`ui-toggle-desc`). "Premium Trader aanbod weergeven" gets "(niet keuringsklaar, max. 6 jaar / 80.000 km)" as its description (the shared `vehicle.with_premium` string is split in the blade, the qualifier has its own key). The "Met afstandslimitaties" switch and select share the control column (`ui-toggle-control`). Colour fields: narrow `#` box, value left-aligned in mono, plus a swatch that paints what is typed. The fontpicker button is styled as a `ui-input` select (field fill, border, chevron, no shadow); the widget itself is untouched. The phone rule of PR 399 still holds (the `--field` row collapses to one column under 576px); `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest` pins the grid version.

**AI.** The three prose fields grow with their content (the component's opt-in autogrow: min ~6 lines, max 60vh, then scroll) on paper white with a clear border (`ui-input--paper`). The component got one more grow after Alpine's flush, because a field inside a pane still under `x-cloak` measured 0 at init. Each switch says in one line what it does, quoted from the code: Flexlease and Verlengde waarborg RG each add one fixed sentence (`vehicle.ai_flexlease_message` / `vehicle.ai_real_garant_message`) to the facts for the own-fleet AI text, for a vehicle that qualifies (`Vehicle::getAiFactsOwnAttribute`); the fixed text gives a new vehicle that text as its own-fleet description and the AI then only writes the Stocklist text unless "deze keer toch" is ticked (`VehicleObserver::creating`, `VehicleTextController`). The inline jQuery that toggled the description box is Alpine now.

## Tests

New `SettingsSayWhatTheyAreTest` (13 tests): download 200 + attachment header for the own dealer and for the administrator on the platform row, 404 for another dealer / no platform right / unknown type, 403 without the pane right, button hidden without a background; key label, help and chip; attachment Alpine wiring; support address from config, no literal in the pane; warranty chip, "Wachtwoord verwijderen", no "Reset password"; website row structure and CSS; AI autogrow, paper, descriptions, no jQuery. `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest` updated for the grid CSS. Ran `Settings|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: 78 tests, 1034 assertions, all green except `TransportChainTest::test_the_settings_tab_shows_the_preview_amounts` which fails only against my seeded local database and passes on a clean one (verified).

## Rule

R P2-10.21 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`. These are requests, not defects: no finding files.

## Open points

- The 503 page (`resources/views/errors/503.blade.php`) still carries the address literally; switch it to `config('variable.support_email')` in a follow-up.
- The "Weergave" heading on the website tab sits at the top of its column (level with "Iframe url"), not on the baseline of "Websiteopties" further down the left column; left as is.
- Screenshots: the fontpicker shows empty locally because Google Fonts is blocked in the screenshot run.

## Re-propose

Second proposal (branch `-2`): `SmokeTest::paginasMetId()` now visits `settings.show.background` with `dark`; the seed has no background, so that is the honest 404 the test accepts. `SmokeTest` locally: only the three `ownvehicle.edit` cases fail, on a missing built `public/js/vehicle/create.js` in my worktree (CI builds assets first).
params.title: Settings: download a background, see the chosen attachment, read the support address
